steps.text: Refer to Fig. 3 and attach the variable speed spring and housing to the governor as follows: a. On current governors, use a new gasket and attach the spring housing cover to the spring housing with a screw and a lock washer. b. If removed, start the variable speed spring plunger guide straight in the boss inside the governor housing and tap it into place with a small brass rod and hammer. c. Lubricate the small end of the variable speed spring plunger with engine oil. Then insert the plunger in the plunger guide inside the governor housing.
